content.short: Brazilian payments and stablecoin infrastructure that converts BRL to stablecoins via PIX in under a minute.
content.description: Trace Finance lets exchanges, fintechs and global companies operate in Brazil without a local entity. Through one API they can hold BRL, USD and EUR accounts, convert reais to stablecoins through PIX in under a minute, and settle cross-border payments around the clock, weekends included. It has processed more than $10 billion for clients such as dLocal, OKX and Bybit, and raised a $32 million Series A led by CoinFund.
content.meta: Trace Finance converts BRL to stablecoins via PIX in under a minute and settles LatAm payments 24/7 by API.
